title: Macro Impact Dashboard
stamp: As of Wednesday, August 19, 2026, 2:25pm ET, hours after Treasury doubled its long end buybacks.
banner: One event set the tone. Treasury doubled long end buybacks to at least **$4bn** per operation, the 30 year fell from Tuesday's 19 year high of **5.34%** to **5.19%**, and the 10 year eased to **4.65%**. Every asset here reprices off that single line, which is why three of the four verdicts still carry a cap.

assets.name: US Stocks
assets.one: Growth and credit both say go. Valuation says do not miss a quarter.
assets.qual: capped, valuation leaves no room for an earnings miss

factors.b: ISM Manufacturing PMI hit **55.6** in July, the strongest print since May 2022 and consistent with real GDP growing about **2.8%** annualised.
The ICE BofA US high yield OAS closed at **275** basis points, near the tight end of its post 2007 range and a green light for equity risk.
The S&P 500 trades at **31.3x** trailing earnings against a **17.6x** long run average, so any miss has to be absorbed by price.

assets.name: US Cash
assets.one: Real carry of 1.37 percent and no cuts priced. The only cost is being out of the rally.
assets.qual: no qualifier, the carry is intact and nothing in the price threatens it

factors.b: The 3 month T bill yields **3.87%** against core CPI of **2.5%**, so 3.87 minus 2.5 = **1.37** percent of real return for zero duration risk.
Fed funds effective sits at **3.63%** with the target held at 3.50 to 3.75, and futures put roughly a **34%** chance on a September hike versus under **1%** on a cut.
With VIX at **15.84** and the S&P within **1.6%** of its August 13 record, holding cash through a risk on tape is a real opportunity cost.

assets.name: Gold
assets.one: A weak dollar and a live war premium, running straight into the 200 day.
assets.qual: capped, the 200 day near $4,510 sits directly overhead

factors.b: DXY fell **0.76%** to **98.90** today and remains beneath a flat 200 day EMA near **99.75** that has capped every attempt for a fortnight.
The 10 year breakeven rose to **2.30%** from **2.24%** on August 13 as Brent held near **$91** on the Hormuz closure.
Spot at roughly **$4,490** after a **3.5%** day runs into the 200 day simple moving average near **$4,510**, the level that has rejected every advance since early June.

assets.name: Crypto
assets.one: Yields relented and the shorts got run over, but BTC is still under its 200 day.
assets.qual: capped, BTC is still below its 200 day average near $75,062

factors.b: Treasury doubling buybacks to at least **$4bn** per operation knocked the 30 year from Tuesday's **5.34%** high to **5.19%** and drove BTC from roughly **$64,100** to a **$69,600** high, now near **$68,000**.
Spot BTC ETFs took in **$297.6mn** on Monday with no fund reporting a redemption, reversing a three session outflow run.
The 10 year real yield sits at **2.44%**, the highest opportunity cost crypto has faced this cycle for an asset that pays no coupon.
